To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the best way to provide a distributed education is to use synchronous delivery for the majority of the class time, with asynchronous delivery used to provide additional support, and that this is best done in the context of in-person instruction.
a blended approach of both synchronous and asynchronous delivery modes is more effective than either mode alone.

the best way to provide distributed education is with synchronous delivery of lectures and discussions and asynchronous delivery of quizzes, tutorials, and assignments, and that this combination is most effective with the addition of in-person instruction.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an effective and flexible learning environment that is accessible to a large number of students and provides a high degree of support for student learning and success.
the following question: How do the various components of an Internet distributed education system interact to provide the most effective learning experience?
the development and implementation of a distributed education system that provides maximum flexibility for the student while maintaining a high level of learning.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the combination of synchronous and asynchronous Internet distributed education, when designed and implemented with a student-centric philosophy, is the most effective way to deliver a course.
synchronous and asynchronous delivery are not competing delivery models, but are complimentary delivery modes.
synchronous delivery of Internet distributed education is an important component of a blended approach that can offer maximum effectiveness in the learning process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a successful and flexible model for delivery of distributed education that is accessible to a wide variety of students and that provides a high degree of flexibility and support for the students.
the synchronous mode provides the best learning environment for our students, while the asynchronous mode is the most convenient way to provide the content.

synchronous delivery provides an opportunity for students to interact with the instructor and with other students and that asynchronous delivery provides a means to reinforce the concepts learned in class and to allow students to work at their own pace.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Internet is a valuable tool to support learning, but it must be integrated with other learning tools, including in-person instruction.
synchronous delivery is not only possible but is a very powerful tool to enhance student learning and to provide a sense of community in a distance learning environment.
synchronous delivery can be a powerful and effective tool in the educational arsenal.
